statement:
The real goal of science is human
understanding, not just correct answers.

Rules for AI in science should be set by the
public, not just by scientists and publishers.

A result with no human author should still
count as a real scientific contribution.

Science should deliberately slow down in the
age of AI, even if it means fewer discoveries.

Within 10 years, most new scientific findings
will come from AI agents, not human scientists.
